extDescription.message: Save the open Deep Review as one interactive offline HTML file.

startOnReview.message: Click the extension button in a tab displaying a Deep Review.

sourceMoved.message: The original Deep Review tab closed or navigated to another page.

alreadyRunning.message: An export is already running in this tab.

tooLarge.message: The document exceeds the export limit of 160 Mi characters.

loadingTimeout.message: Could not confirm loading. Wait for the review to finish displaying and try again.

filterMissing.message: The comment filter option was not found.

canvasFailed.message: Could not start converting a page image.

imageRestricted.message: Browser image-access restrictions prevent export. Use a local Chrome save instead.

reviewOnly.message: Run this from a Google Deep Review document page.

reviewMissing.message: Review UI not found. Sign in and wait for the review to display.

documentLoading.message: The address and displayed review do not match yet. Wait for loading and try again.

checkingComments.message: Checking comments and linked regions in Comments view.

incompleteDocument.message: Could not reach the end. The document is too large or this UI is unsupported.

identityChanged.message: Document or review version changed during capture. Retry from the current review.

captureDiagnostic.message: The source provides no total comment count. Captured bodies, links and page continuity were checked. Comments dismissed before export may be absent.

invalidSnapshot.message: Supported Deep Review data was not found. Retry from the displayed review.

emptySnapshot.message: Paper pages or detailed comments are empty. Check that the review has loaded.

duplicateIds.message: Comment IDs are empty or duplicated.

pageOrder.message: Page images are missing or their sequence is invalid.

brokenLink.message: A highlight/comment link is broken. Check All Types.

unanchoredComment.message: A comment has no linked region. Wait for page loading and retry.

invalidComment.message: Could not read a comment body or severity.

jobTimeout.message: Response timed out. Check the original tab and try again.

resourceFailed.message: Could not read the packaged extension file: $1

savedStatus.message: Open the saved HTML without an internet connection or login.

startFromTab.message: Start by clicking the extension button in a Deep Review tab.

permissionMissing.message: No permission to read this tab. Click the extension button in the original review tab again.

sourceDisconnected.message: The source tab disconnected. Open the original review and try again.

chunkOrder.message: Review data arrived out of order.

missingChunks.message: Some review data did not arrive.

cancelCleanupFailed.message: Cancellation could not remove the file. Check Chrome Downloads: $1

localHint.message: You may close this tab when finished. Document content can contain personal data. No automatic anonymization or encryption is applied.
